title: ampelopsis striata
intro: Ampelopsis striata, commonly known as Chinese pepper vine, is a plant species native to Asia, belonging to the Vitaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. Therapeutically, Ampelopsis striata is used to stimulate circulation, relieve pain, and lower fever, making it a popular choice in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
